svg.aria-label: I work on the layer that decides whether an LLM system survives contact with production: how models are adapted, how agents are evaluated, and how both run as dependable software. Right now that means LoRA fine-tuning infrastructure for open-weight models, a statistical CI gate for LLM agents, and the Python and TypeScript services around them. Working rule across every project below: if a number was not measured, it is not shown.
